cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: New Rule Required
cards.instruction: Use every problem as justification for adding another rule, ceremony, checkpoint, or layer of oversight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. You spilled one cup. From now on, drinks need pouring permits. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I'll appoint a pouring supervisor.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What if the supervisor spills one?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. I'll add an appeals procedure before we serve anything.

mechanism: A responds to a spilled drink with permits, takes the first supervisory task and gives B new oversight when B identifies the supervisor risk.
confusable: Unlike following an existing safety policy, A invents new requirements from each problem raised.
comparison: Pouring and inspecting hands differ from rehearsal timing for a family photograph.
seedUse: D192-a pouring permits and supervisor risk; S02-a grants B inspection while keeping A organizing role.
